title: Narrative Reward
description: EEG dataset from forty participants who read an interactive story containing decision points. On each trial participants saw an item, made a yes/no decision, and received correct or incorrect feedback. The design compares a narrative condition, with story context at item onset and after feedback, against a nonnarrative condition with no such context. It is intended for studying how narrative context affects reward and feedback processing.
methods_description: Participants read a story with interactive decision points and made yes/no decisions about presented items, then received correct or incorrect feedback. Narrative trials were blocked hierarchically: narrative text was shown when entering and leaving a location and before each sub-location. Three locations were visited, each with three sub-locations of 6 items.
